name: Roborock Qrevo Curv (US)

radios.note: Roborock's US page says the robot supports 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi only.

matter.note: Roborock's April 2025 announcement lists the Qrevo Curv among models getting Matter by firmware update. No CSA listing was found; the claim rests on the maker's statement.

apple_home.note: Roborock says Matter lets the Home app control compatible vacuums; functionality varies by ecosystem and detailed settings stay in the Roborock app.

google_home.note: Roborock's US page lists voice commands through Google Home; the Matter announcement also names Google Home.

alexa.note: Roborock's US page lists voice commands through Amazon Alexa; the Matter announcement also names Alexa.

smartthings.note: No Roborock or Samsung page found for SmartThings.

home_assistant.note: Home Assistant has an official Roborock integration, but its page does not list the Qrevo Curv and says newer Q-series devices are not fully supported. Model support not confirmed.

hubRequired.note: The multifunctional dock is not a hub; the robot connects over Wi-Fi.

localControl.note: No maker statement on local-only control found.

cleaning.note: Vacuums and mops with spinning pads.

navigation.note: Navigation name from Roborock's global Qrevo Curv page.

suctionPa.note: HyperForce suction; Roborock says values may vary by country or region.

selfEmptying.note: Multifunctional Dock 3.0 empties the bin automatically.

summary: Roborock lists the Qrevo Curv as a vacuum and mop with 18,500 Pa suction and a dock that empties the bin on its own. It works with Alexa and Google Home voice control and received Matter by firmware update in April 2025.
